    n = len(arr)
    halfsum = []
    max_mask = 1 << n
    for mask in range(max_mask):
        total = 0
        for j in range(n):
            if (mask & (1 << j)) != 0:
                total += arr[j]
                total %= m
        halfsum.append(total)
    return halfsum
